name: Aerogility
summary: Model-based AI and digital twin for long-term maintenance planning, forecasting heavy checks and engine shop visits; Wizz Air selected it in February 2026.
paragraphs: Model-based AI and digital twin for long-term maintenance planning, forecasting heavy checks and engine shop visits; Wizz Air selected it in February 2026.
whyItMatters: Lets planners test fleet growth and check scheduling scenarios years ahead; customers include easyJet, SAS, Vueling and Jetstar.
